company.name: Khazanay
company.headquarters: Plot 6C, Zamzama Commercial, DHA Phase-V, Karachi, Pakistan
company.description: Khazanay is Pakistan's pre-loved footwear marketplace, selling 100% authentic, personally-inspected used shoes from top international brands like Nike, Adidas, Asics, and New Balance — imported from the USA and sold at up to 80% off retail, with transparent condition grading and a 7-day return policy.
company.mission: Make authentic, name-brand footwear affordable and accessible to budget-conscious shoppers across Pakistan, while giving quality shoes a second life.
company.brand_story: Khazanay sources genuine, gently-used shoes from top athletic and lifestyle brands abroad, personally inspects every pair for authenticity and condition, and grades them transparently (Premium+, Premium, Excellent, Very Good) before listing them online — letting Pakistani shoppers buy real Nike, Adidas, and Asics at a fraction of retail price, backed by a 7-day return window.

product.name: Nike Quest 4
product.description: Pre-loved Nike Quest 4 running shoe, EUR 38.5 / UK 5 / USA 7.5, graded 'Excellent' condition (very little signs of wear). 100% authentic, personally inspected, imported from the USA.
key_features: Condition-graded: Excellent (very little signs of wear)
Unedited product photos show the shoe's actual condition
key_benefits: Genuine Nike running shoe at a fraction of retail price
Verified authenticity — no risk of counterfeits
A more sustainable choice than buying new
unique_selling_points: Every pair personally inspected for authenticity before listing
Transparent condition grading system, not just 'used'
Imported inventory unavailable new in local retail
product.pricing_details: PKR 7,099 (compare at PKR 9,465) — price varies by size and condition grade

audience.geography: Karachi and Lahore primarily, nationwide shipping across Pakistan
values: Value for money without sacrificing quality
audience.lifestyle: Urban, active, price-sensitive but unwilling to compromise on brand authenticity
audience.purchase_behavior: Browses by brand and size, compares condition grade against price, checks return policy before buying, often discovers via social ads or search for a specific brand at a discount
audience.device_usage: Mobile-first — majority of browsing and buying via smartphone
audience.buying_trigger: Seeing a favorite brand (Nike, Adidas, Asics) available in their size at a steep discount, or a limited-time sale
pain_points: Name-brand shoes are expensive at full retail in Pakistan
Worried about counterfeits when buying 'cheap' branded shoes online
Limited size availability for imported brands locally
desired_outcomes: Own genuine Nike/Adidas/Asics without paying full retail price
Feel confident the shoes are authentic and accurately described
Find their exact size in a brand not easily available new in Pakistan
objections: Is a 'used' shoe really worth buying — how used is it, really?
What if the condition doesn't match what's described?
Is this actually authentic, or a counterfeit sold as 'preloved'?
audience.emotional_state: Excited by the idea of an authentic brand-name deal, but cautious/skeptical about buying used footwear online until reassured

voice_examples: Real Nike. Real Asics. Up to 80% off retail.
Personally inspected. Honestly graded. No surprises.
Your size, your brand, a fraction of the price.
dos: Lead with the brand name and the discount — that's the hook
Be explicit about condition grading, never hide that items are pre-owned
Use real, unedited product photography — authenticity is the whole pitch
Create urgency around size/stock scarcity (only one pair per size exists)
donts: Never imply the shoes are brand new
Do not overuse discount/sale language to the point it feels untrustworthy
Avoid glossy, overly-retouched stock photography — it undercuts the 'real condition' promise
Never guarantee availability of a specific size — inventory is one-of-a-kind per pair
brand.imagery_style: clean, real, unedited product photography that shows the shoe's actual condition — no artificial gloss
brand.visual_do: Show the real product clearly and honestly, clean neutral backgrounds, condition grade visible
brand.visual_dont: No overly retouched or stock photography — it undermines the 'real condition, real price' promise

competitive.positioning_statement: The same authentic global brands sold in official retail stores — at up to 80% off, with transparent condition grading and a return policy for peace of mind
primary_differentiators: Imported selection of sizes/models not always available new in Pakistan
7-day return window most resale sellers don't offer

competitors.name: Official brand retail stores (Nike/Adidas outlets in Pakistan)
competitors.our_differentiator: Same authentic brands at up to 80% off, with honest condition grading instead of a full-price-only option.

competitors.name: Unverified resale sellers (Facebook Marketplace, OLX)
competitors.our_differentiator: Personally inspected authenticity and a 7-day return window — not a gamble on a stranger's listing.

competitive.competitive_advantages_summary: Khazanay is positioned between full-price official retail and risky peer-to-peer resale — authentic, graded, and returnable, at resale prices.

guarantees: 100% authenticity — every pair personally inspected before listing

preferred_cta_styles: Grab Your Size Before It's Gone
Up to 80% Off — Shop the Sale
marketing.average_sales_cycle: Impulse to same-session — shoppers browse by brand/size and buy quickly once they find their size at the right price
best_performing_content_types: Before/after price comparison (retail vs Khazanay price)
value_propositions: Real Nike, Adidas, and Asics — up to 80% off retail
Every pair personally inspected and honestly condition-graded
One-of-a-kind inventory — once a size sells, it's gone

restricted_claims: Cannot describe items as 'brand new' — all inventory is pre-owned/used
Condition grade stated in ads must match the item's actual listed grade
required_disclaimers: Items are pre-owned/used — condition grading applies, not brand new
7-day return window applies to size/fit issues
